metadata.case_name: CHAN KAI MAN v. BAIQIAN INTERNATIONAL HOLDING LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: cross-border lorry driver (employed by Uni-Link Logistics Ltd.)
plaintiff.education_level: received education in Mainland China up to level 5 in primary school

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his low back; back sprain resulting in residual pain
source: Both Dr Lam and Dr Chiang agreed that Chan suffered soft tissue injury to his low back which injury was consistent with the mechanism of injury described if the Accident did happen.
Chan was assessed to have sustained back sprain resulting in residual pain.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: right buttock numbness on prolonged sitting for over an hour; numbness in the buttock when lying on one side during long sleep
tenderness and stiffness over the 2nd and 3rd lumbar paraspinal muscle
range of spinal movement was markedly limited in flexion
decreased sensation over the whole right foot
mild tenderness over the lumbar paraspinal muscle with muscle tightness and guarding without muscle spasm; mild tenderness over the lumbosacral junction and the sacrum

treatments_received.treatment: consultation at Hui Kok Yin Bone Injuries Clinic
source: he went to consult a Chinese medical practitioner in 許國賢骨傷科醫館 (Hui Kok Yin Bone Injuries Clinic) on 3 August 2012.

treatments_received.treatment: Accident & Emergency Department attendance at Queen Mary Hospital; analgesics; discharged with two days sick leave
source: Due to intensifying pain, Chan went to the Accident & Emergency Department of Queen Mary Hospital for treatment at about 4 am of 4 August 2012. ... X-ray of lumbar spine showed no fracture. He was given analgesics and discharged with two days sick leave granted to him.

treatments_received.treatment: consultations at Sai Ying Pun Clinic (Family Medicine); referred to physiotherapy; oral analgesics
source: Chan subsequently attended the Sai Ying Pun Clinic (Family Medicine) (“SYPC”) for consultation and treatment for 5 times on 22, 24 and 28 August 2012, and 3 and 5 September 2012. ... Doctor’s diagnosis was back sprain and radiculopathy. Chan was referred to physiotherapy. He was discharged with oral analgesics.

treatments_received.treatment: medical treatment in Dongguan City (physiotherapy/clinic attendances in January, March and October 2013)
source: it also appears from the medical receipts produced by Chan that he had sought medical treatment in Dongguan City in January, March and October 2013.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA)
